terms.meaning: a way to draw an element at the top level of the page, outside its parent

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Panel and trigger setup
sections.what: Sets up the popover parts. The content panel is drawn in a portal with rounded corners, a shadow, animations, and the alignment and gap defaults.
sections.why: Likely reason: a reusable floating panel for menus and small lists.
sections.watch_out: Because the panel is drawn outside its parent, parent styles and layout rules do not reach it.

summary: A floating panel that opens next to a button. The notification center uses it.
purpose: Shows extra content above the page without leaving it.
why: Likely reason: a standard popup kit. The notification center uses this panel.
how: Re-exports the popover root and trigger, and wraps the content panel in a portal so it draws above the rest of the page. Defaults the alignment to center and the gap to 4. Applies rounded corners, a shadow and fade or zoom animations. One long class list is cut off in the sample.
inputs: Props for the root, trigger and content, including align and sideOffset.
risks: A portal draws the panel outside its parent, so styles inherited from the parent do not apply. Part of the class list was cut off in the sample, so some styles are unverified.
debug: If the panel is positioned wrong, check align and sideOffset. If the panel is hidden behind other content, check its z-index class.
